subject: Civil Engineering
title: Level of Service: Grading Road Performance
description: One-minute skill: Level of Service: Grading Road Performance.

hook.text: How do you measure if a road is working? Engineers grade it like a school exam — A to F.

buildup.text: Level of Service A is free-flowing, uncongested. LOS F is breakdown — stop-and-go.

discovery.text: Each road type has its own LOS criteria — freeways use density, signals use delay.

twist.text: Most urban roads are designed for LOS D — some congestion is acceptable, even expected.

climax.text: The Highway Capacity Manual defines LOS — the global standard for traffic analysis.

punchline.text: Roads get report cards. Failing means it's time to redesign.

quiz.question: What does Level of Service (LOS) A represent?
options: Free-flowing traffic with minimal delay or congestion
The road is closed for maintenance
